title: Genomic Characterization of RTK-RAS Pathway Alterations in Juvenile Myelomonocytic Leukemia Through Whole-Exome Sequencing.
snippet: Juvenile myelomonocytic leukemia (JMML) is a rare and very aggressive pediatric myelodysplastic/myeloproliferative neoplasm with molecular heterogeneity and constitutive activation of the RAS signaling pathway.
